intent: Design an agentic system framed as a startup company structure — flat, low-bureaucracy — where a founder orchestrator delegates work to IC agents and synthesizes results back into a coherent deliverable that respects user intent.
tldr: Landing-page spec frozen (audience=hiring/portfolio, CTA=star on GitHub, host=docs/index.html + GitHub Pages); next step is designer ‖ marketer fan-out, then serial builder, then critic ship gate.
mental_model: Dry-run as topology validator: the goal is to fire every loop edge once (parallel fan-out, serial dependency, marketer-only blackboard write, critic gate, two stage-reports), not to ship a polished page.

Audience choice as tone lock: hiring/portfolio → polished, design-thinking-forward; constrains designer (whitespace, type) and marketer (claim accuracy, no hype) jointly so their parallel outputs converge.
Fan-out boundary is the spec: designer and marketer can run in parallel only because spec fixes audience + CTA + host before they start; without that frozen contract their outputs silently diverge.

Builder serializes on creative outputs: index.html cannot be written until layout (designer) + copy (marketer) both land, so the loop bottleneck is the slower of the two — pick smaller scope first if budget tight.
Critic as the only authorized claim-checker: founder synthesis is fast but partial; Critic verifies the 'polished hiring surface' claim against the actual artifact, not against the spec.

state_delta.text: Dry-run intent locked: landing page for google-agent-skill repo (intent B).
Audience = hiring / portfolio surface; tone polished, design-thinking-forward.
Primary CTA = star on GitHub. Secondary = read the topology doc.
Active spec slice 'landing page' appended to blackboard ## Spec with 5 content blocks: hero, topology diagram, mental model, tradeoffs, tech footer.
Non-goals fixed: no signup, no analytics, no backend, no JS framework. Single static HTML + inlined or CDN CSS.
Mermaid diagram from prior IC-roster report is reusable as a starting point; designer restyles, does not redraw from scratch.

Designer and marketer fan-out may produce conflicting tone (designer leans visual minimalism, marketer leans persuasive claims). Needs founder mediation pass; exercises the conflict-resolution edge intentionally.
GitHub Pages must be enabled manually in repo settings; out of scope for this dry-run, but the page is unreachable publicly until that step is taken.

open_questions.text: Reuse the IC-roster Mermaid graph verbatim, or simplify it for the landing-page audience?
open_questions.default_if_silent: Simplify — drop decision/milestone nodes; keep founder + 5 ICs + blackboard only.

open_questions.text: Include a 'what was deliberately NOT built' (no DAG, no middle managers, no per-IC writes) section?
open_questions.default_if_silent: Yes — that tradeoffs framing is the design-thinking signal hiring readers want.

open_questions.text: Word count target for marketer copy?
open_questions.default_if_silent: Hero ≤ 20 words; each section ≤ 80 words; total page ≤ 400 words.

open_questions.text: Defer GitHub Pages enable to a follow-up commit, or block ship on it?
open_questions.default_if_silent: Defer — document the manual enable step in a footer note; do not block the dry-run.
